title: Kenyan Avocado Shake
community: Urban Kenya — the café shake that always surprises
author: Mama Wanjiru
desc: Kenyan Avocado Shake — two whole ripe Kenyan avocados blended with cold milk, honey, and a squeeze of lime into a rich, impossibly creamy, pale green shake. The shake that astonishes newcomers to Kenyan café culture — richer than any dairy milkshake, lighter than any dessert.
longDesc: The avocado shake is one of the most distinctive things you can drink in a Kenyan café. Thick, pale green, and unbelievably creamy, it is a shake made entirely from fruit fat rather than dairy fat — and the result is something the world outside Kenya has not yet fully discovered. For Kenyans, it is completely normal. For visitors, it is a revelation.
steps: Scoop avocado flesh into the blender.
Add cold milk, honey, lime juice, vanilla, salt, and ice.
Blend on high speed for 45—60 seconds until completely smooth and creamy.
Taste and adjust honey and lime.
chefTips: Drink immediately — avocado oxidises and browns quickly after blending.
The lime juice slows browning slightly and adds essential acidity.
Kenyan avocados — large, buttery, and rich — make this incomparably better than imported varieties.
cookingScience: See KEN138 for avocado fat composition science. In shake form, the avocado fat droplets are emulsified by high-speed blending with milk, creating a stable, ultra-fine emulsion with exceptional mouthfeel — the same mechanism that makes avocado-based dressings and dips so creamy.
sustainabilityTips: Kenya's local avocados make this one of the most sustainable milkshake alternatives available.
healthBenefits: High in potassium, vitamins K, C, and B6.
Very filling — the fat and fibre combination provides prolonged satiety.
culturalNote: The avocado shake is one of the most surprising and delightful discoveries in Kenyan café culture for international visitors — a completely normal Kenyan drink that astonishes people from countries where avocado is expensive and treated with reverence. In Kenya, avocados are so abundant that blending two of them into a shake is perfectly natural.
